series: How I grew AI brains from zero

videos.title: I gave two species blank AI brains. The hunters starved.
Evolution made my AI hunters nearly blind
My AI hunters barely beat one line of code
My AI hunters only got smart when they had to surround their prey
I let evolution decide how big my AI's brain should be
I gave my AI hunters hills. They took the high ground.
A viewer said my AI hunters should hide. So I let them.
I gave my AI creatures poisoned food, and they learned to taste
My AI seemed to learn with no memory. Then I counted the dead worlds.
I let my AI hunters eat plants. They stopped hunting.
My AI hunters split in two. Then I found the catch.
My AI grazers got so good that hunters keep starving.
I gave my AI creatures three different worlds. Evolution proved me wrong.
I made size matter. My AI hunters grew bigger, and died out.
My AI hunters evolved camouflage. One world never could.
